name: X Thread & Article Writer
tagline: Turns rough notes into a paste-ready X thread and longform piece
description: Give it a half-formed idea, scattered notes or just a link and it writes both an X thread and a longform draft that sounds like you rather than a press release. Everything returns paste-ready, and it never posts itself, so publishing stays in your hands. For people with something to say and no patience for formatting.
author: sigarellano
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
